title: Stairs or SLIDE down the Great Wall? | China Travel Expert
description:
At Mutianyu, you don't have to walk down the Great Wall. I rode the chairlift up — and took the toboggan slide all the way back down.

Mutianyu, in the mountains north of Beijing, is the section built for this: a chairlift (or cable car) carries you up to the wall, and a stainless-steel toboggan run winds back down through the forest. It's the easiest way onto a restored, less-crowded stretch of wall — and the most fun way off it.

🧭 Expert Tip: At Mutianyu, take the chairlift up and the toboggan down — you save the knees-on-stairs descent and get the best ridgeline views on the way up. Buy the combined lift + toboggan ticket at the base.
